high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a mobile device displaying a TED Talk video titled "How to Build in Space — for Life on Earth" by Ariel Ekblaw. The video has 23K views and was uploaded one day ago. The TED channel has 2.62 crore subscribers. At the top of the screen, there is a graph showing the cost per kilogram for space launches across the globe since 1960. The graph includes data points for various spacecraft such as the Space Shuttle, Soyuz, Saturn V, Delta Heavy, Long March 3b, Falcon 9, Angara, and Star
